hooks.name: Auto Commit, Pull Latest, and Push on Turn End
hooks.description: After an agent turn completes, stage all changes and commit with a timestamped message, then pull the latest from origin (rebasing local work on top) so the working copy is on the most up-to-date version before pushing to the current branch.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && BRANCH="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" && git add -A && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "chore: auto-commit ($(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))") && git pull --rebase origin "$BRANCH" && git push origin "$BRANCH"
